title: ARPAPED Git-Commit Event
description: The fact that a commit was made, recorded as its own DEP event -- written by blueprint.dep.git_commit_event (2-RULES.md glossary: git-commit event). Independent of runtime-event.schema.json (own module, own shape, no shared code) -- a commit is an agent/operator action, not a capability's Bridge call. DEP references git here (the operator's own instruction: reference git commits/branches/tags where relevant) without depending on it as DEP's storage model -- every other blueprint/dep/ artifact works with zero git involvement; this is the one piece whose whole job IS to record that a git action happened.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601, UTC -- when this event was recorded, not necessarily the commit's own author/commit date.

commit.description: Full 40-character sha, from a real `git rev-parse` probe -- never guessed, never abbreviated.

branch.description: Best-effort: the branch HEAD was on when probed. Omitted for a detached HEAD or if the probe fails.

message.description: The commit's own subject+body, verbatim from `git log`, never reworded or summarized.

author.description: Best-effort `name <email>`, from `git log`. Omitted if the probe fails.

files_changed.description: Best-effort, from `git diff-tree`. Omitted (not emptied) if the probe fails -- an empty array would falsely claim 'zero files changed', which is different from 'not probed'.
